records.title: SMMBench: A Benchmark for Source-Distributed Multimodal Agent Memory
records.reason: SMMBench is an evaluation benchmark for source-distributed multimodal agent memory. Full text focuses on benchmark tasks and evaluation; it does not provide a memory compression, retrieval-latency, token-cost, or serving optimization method, though the linked memory lineage makes the benchmark potentially useful context.

records.title: AV-DTEC: Self-Supervised Audio–Visual Fusion for Drone 3-D Trajectory Estimation and Classification
records.reason: The IEEE DOI source could not be retrieved through the primary-source endpoint; no publisher/author primary abstract or full text was available to verify scope or efficiency claims.

records.title: Learning to Build the Environment: Self-Evolving Reasoning RL via Verifiable Environment Synthesis
records.reason: EvoEnv synthesizes executable training environments for reasoning RL and reports post-training capability changes. Its reusable environments alter training data/reward generation, not inference cost.

records.title: From Text to Voice: A Reproducible and Verifiable Framework for Evaluating Tool Calling LLM Agents
records.reason: The primary paper constructs an audio-converted benchmark and evaluation protocol for tool-calling agents; it reports model accuracy gaps, not a tool-call, latency, memory, or inference optimization.

records.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
records.reason: CiteVQA introduces an evidence-attribution benchmark and scoring metric. Its automated annotation uses MLLMs, but the paper’s contribution is evaluation and reliability auditing rather than reduced inference resources.
